designReview.evidence: The independent 2026-09-28 review rates D01-05 at 78/80; its course-by-course Q16 entry and §17 generation boundary are included in the shared review report.

criteria.evidence: 05-shadow-riddle.md §4 separates intent/control selection from the one-variable light-radius test; §17 keeps both local.
Section 4 names overlapping projected features and requires fixed conditions, actual shadow output and a same-view retry.
Sections 3 and 7 transfer the riddle test to an alternate audience guess while holding other conditions stable.
Sections 3-4 diagnose changed light size as a single variable and explicitly reject a pasted silhouette as a real shadow.
Section 4 feedback refers to visible projected features and prompts one controlled adjustment before another test.
Sections 7 and 10 require editable v01/v02, actual projected images, controlled comparison and real audience response.
